notes: Reviewed pins of each official HTKK distribution the native harness may use as its oracle. Data only: no installer bytes, no extracted source.
5.8.1 stays the default oracle. 5.8.2 and 5.8.3 are selectable (workflow input htkk_version) for non-gating cohorts; they never feed release, Pages or scoped evidence.

Method status: reviewed = the body the driver was written against; token-renumbered = same instructions as the reviewed 5.8.1 body once metadata tokens are resolved to names (new token, new raw IL hash); changed = the body really differs and is NOT accepted as the reviewed body; changed-reviewed = the body really differs, its new body was reviewed against the driver plan ('review') and is accepted for that version only (the 5.8.1 pins are unchanged). added-reviewed = a method of a later release only (absent from the default oracle, e.g. U5 3.1.0 CnkdHkd01TT50Nckt310 of 5.8.2; the pbt-582-* pins of the 05-1/PBT-KK-TNCN import plan, cases run on 5.8.2 only), pinned as itself with its review for that version only.
Generated consumers: HtkkOracleBaseline.ps1 and HtkkOracleBaseline.cs (python3 scripts/generate-htkk-oracle-baselines.py [--check]).

5.8.2.mainWindowCaption: Hỗ trợ kê khai thuế - Phiên bản 5.8.2

methods.change: Menu-ID lists gain Z8 and a new control type 110 branch (24666 -> 25029 IL bytes).
methods.review: Token-normalised diff against 5.8.1: seven literals 'D1,...,Y6,Z8,Z5' become '...,Z5,Z8' (Z8 appended; Y8 in neither) and one inserted branch Controltype == '110' (GetMaTieuMucGep into indexColumnSelectedValue); nothing else. 01_NTNN_NCCNN_TT89_309.xml (byte-identical in 5.8.2) has only control types 0/1/2/14/15/16/26/87, so the Y8 entry path (control 87 BX code, 14 dates, 16 numbers) runs the same instructions. Accepted for 5.8.2 only.

methods.change: Four edits (9783 -> 9939 IL bytes): F5 big-data branch null-checks dataInfoOld; the existing D4/Z3 two-row cap (0585) is split, D4 keeping table 0 and Z3 now capping table 1; the F6 big-data P2 special case is removed; F6 on the last remaining row also resets RowsValues[0] to GetRowValueDefault.
methods.review: Every edit is gated off the Y8 entry plan: the big-data branches need Sheet TaiDuLieuRatLon=1 (Y8 sheet 01 has none in Menu.xml), the 0585 cap needs MenuID D4 or Z3, the GetRowValueDefault reset is in the F6 (delete row) path; the driver sends only F5 and needs no insert (one template row per table, Tables rows required 1). The F5 non-big-data path is instruction-identical. Accepted for 5.8.2 only.

Sheet 01 bind after the original import (ProcessSheet -> WinDoWorkEvent.AutoBindData): writes the period type cell BM58, header locks (lockUnLockHeaderCheck), then lockUnLockA_TK and ThayDoiTieuMucA. Leaves AJ (chonGiamThue, not in the XML) unticked and open when CE > 0. Reviewed against the U5 3.1.0 import-tick plan; 5.8.2 only (the class is absent from 5.8.1).

For every table_1/table_2 row: AJ := (CE > 0 ? AJ : false) and AJ.Locked := !(CE > 0) (CE = ct17_soThueGoc, XLS formula of U, Z and BM). So AJ291/AJ293 are open after the import and after the L291 retype. Reviewed against the U5 3.1.0 import-tick plan; 5.8.2 only.

Edited cell of sheet 01 (1-based iRow/iCol from winFpSpread_CellChange): column L copies L into U; for any table row SetCacDongCon fills the child-row keys (BN, BK, CA, BS, BO, BP) of the whole table; on table_1/table_2 rows except column AJ it re-derives AJ from CE, then daySangPLGiamThue and capNhatToKhai, tinhCt14_tk, the [18]-[20] totals and section D. Reviewed against the plan's L291 edits; 5.8.2 only.

Copies the location header of the edited table (ma/ten dia diem, xa, tru so chinh) and the taxpayer MST into the hidden child-row columns BS/BN/BO/BP/BK/CA of every row of that table via GeneralFunctions.SetLaiDongConBangF5. The XML import does not fill them (no XML path), so the plan edits L291 once before the ticks. Reviewed; 5.8.2 only.

Checkbox click on sheet 01 (0-based idxRow/idxCol from WinDoWorkEvent.ButtonClick): lockUnLockA_TK; when idxCol + 1 = AJ it re-derives AJ/lock of the cell one row above (idxRow - 1, an HTKK off-by-one that only touches the row above the clicked one: header row 290 or the unticked row 292), then for a table_1/table_2 row (DetectIndexOfTable(idxRow + 1)) daySangPLGiamThue; always capNhatToKhai. Reviewed against the AJ291/AJ293 ticks; 5.8.2 only.

PL 01 (sheet index 3) is rebuilt by CopyTableToTable5(deleteDataOld = true, colCompare AJ, valueCompare 'true') from the ticked table_1/table_2 rows (BK->D, BN->C, CB->E, CC->I, C->F, BM->K, CE->G, CA->N, BR->L, BY->M); then CD of a ticked row := H of the first unused PL 01 row with the same C/I/K (O := true), CD of an unticked row := 0. Reviewed; 5.8.2 only.

CF (thue bu) of table_1/table_2 rows from PL 03 (sheet index 4) only when PL 03 is present and header (1)/(2) applies; without PL 03 CF stays 0, so AE = CE - CD + CF = CE - CD. Reviewed against the PL 01-only plan; 5.8.2 only.

With deleteDataOld it first removes the extra data rows of the target table and resets its template row to the defaults, then inserts one target row per source row whose compare column text equals valueCompare, copying the mapped columns. So the PL 01 rows imported from the XML are replaced by rows derived from the ticks. Reviewed; added for 5.8.2 only (U5 3.1.0 plan).

Writes one value into one column of every data row of a table (DataLocationTemplateRowStart .. + RowsValues.Count - 1). Used by SetCacDongCon for the child-row key columns. Reviewed; added for 5.8.2 only (U5 3.1.0 plan).

FpSpread.Change handler: after its menu-specific branches it calls WinDoWorkEvent.CellChange(spread, ActiveSheetIndex, e.Row + 1, e.Column + 1) (1-based). Same 5.8.2 body as y8-entry-grid-cellchange (changed-reviewed there: Z8 list entries and control 110 do not reach U5). Pinned again for the U5 3.1.0 plan; 5.8.2 only.

Resolves CellChange_<sheet index> of the business instance by name and invokes it with winFpSpread, ToKhaiInfo, TTinChung, PeriodInfo, iRow, iCol bound by parameter name. Reviewed for the U5 3.1.0 plan (CellChange_0 for sheet 01); added for 5.8.2 only.

FpSpread.ButtonClicked handler: for a ButtonCellType or CheckBoxCellType cell calls WinDoWorkEvent.ButtonClick(spread, e.Row, e.Column) (0-based). Same 5.8.2 body as y8-entry-grid-button (token-renumbered there). Pinned again for the U5 3.1.0 plan; 5.8.2 only.

Resolves ButtonClick_<ActiveSheetIndex> by name and invokes it with idxRow/idxCol bound by parameter name; the MenuID 95 and 01/I5 branches do not apply to U5. Same 5.8.2 body as y8-entry-dowork-button. Pinned again for the U5 3.1.0 plan; 5.8.2 only.

Entering a table cell of control 8 (Thuế tỉnh/CCT) or 9 (CQT quản lý) in a menu of the new-catalogue list (L7, Z8) rebuilds its combobox from the row: loadCqtCapCucTheoDiaBanXa(mã xã of the 101 column) or loadCqtCapChiCucTheoDiaBanXa(mã cấp cục, mã xã), InsertCombobox without clearing the text. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

Table branch: control 8 maps the typed name to its combobox ItemData code (GetDMFromCombobox, First by value) into the SelectedValue column and resets the child CQT quản lý (setSviewCqtCapChiCucTheoMaCqtCuc_Dinamic); control 9 writes its code the same way. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

Row-value overload used by ProcessSelectedCell after Nhập từ XML: for controls 8 and 9 a menu of the new-catalogue list returns without writing a name, so Thuế tỉnh/CCT (no XML leaf) stays empty after the import. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

ProcessParentCell after the import: the empty parent code of a control 9 child becomes the first three digits of its code plus 00 (the cấp cục code); the parent name is not written. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.
Thuế tỉnh/CCT list of a ward: an empty item, the cấp cục of the ward office (MaCQT[0..3] + 00), then 82500 and 82700; nothing for an empty ward. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.
CQT quản lý list of (mã cấp cục, mã xã): 82500 / 82700 alone, otherwise the cấp cục and the ward office of the ward; nothing without a ward. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

After a Thuế tỉnh/CCT choice: the CQT quản lý (control 9) cell of the row gets the new list and its text is cleared (InsertCombobox with clearing), so the plan chooses it again. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

Dictionary overload: ComboBoxCellType Items = names, ItemData = codes, Editable, AutoSearch; the last argument clears the cell text. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan (the typed name is an item name).
Code-to-name dictionary of a combobox cell from its ItemData and Items (first key kept), the source of the code CellChange writes. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

L7 05-1/PBT row checks: E_13 MST (5 digits or MST/CCCD), E_28 duplicate ward, E_40 one head office, E_41 branch province equal to the head office province. The case rows pass them. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.
Z8 05-1/PBT row checks: as L7 plus E_43 (MST required) and a head office MST/CCCD only. The case rows pass them. Reviewed against the 05-1/PBT import plan.

Table branch: a DC_ combobox cell (PL 01-1 column E, Controltype DC_124, SelectedValue I) maps the chosen name to its DM_DUNG_CHUNG code (GetDMFromCombobox) into column I, then WinDoWorkEvent.CellChange runs the sheet's CellChange_1. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Entering the PL 01-1 thuế suất cell by an arrow key gives the editor the DC_124 list (1, 2, 3, 5 with their codes); no other branch applies to menu Z3. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Calls CellChange_<sheet index> of the business class by reflection with the 1-based row and column: CellChange_1 for the PL 01-1 sheet of Z3. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Fills combobox cells of an imported table row from their XML values (the PL 01-1 thuế suất cell E with SelectedValue I); pinned so that a changed import path is detected before the plan runs. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

After the import, sets column E of every PL 01-1 row to getTenThueSuat(column I) and then runs TinhLaiThueSuat_PL01_1; with I still empty, E is cleared before it can be copied to I (run 43772871198, zero mask 4031). Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Reads InterfaceIni/DM_thue_suat_GTGT.xml and returns the name of a rate code (1 -> 1%), an empty string for an empty or unknown code. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Without thu ho: a change of column E with a code in I runs TinhLaiChiTieu22_den_28_TK for every rate, then TinhLaiChiTieu23_25_27_29TheoPL01_1 copies AW87:AW90 into [23]..[29]. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Copies column E into an empty column I of each sale row, then recomputes [22]..[28] and [23]..[29] from the annex. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).

Writes [22], [24], [26], [28] of the tờ khai from the annex totals I9 (1%), L9 (5%), K9 (3%), J9 (2%) when the PL 01-1 sheet is attached. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).
Copies the hidden formulas AW87:AW90 (ROUND(revenue x rate - reduction)) into [23], [25], [27], [29]. Reviewed against the 04/GTGT TT89 PL 01-1 import plan (static reading of HTKK 5.8.2).
